texts.preamble: Heritage Foods Limited & Anr vs Jagati Publications Limited & Ors on 19 February, 2026 $~47 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi + Cs(Os) 162/2026 & I.A. 4826/2026, 4827/2026, 4828/20 4829/2026 Heritage Foods Limited & Anr. ..... P Through: Mr. Sandeep Sethi, Mr. Anurag Ahluwalia, Sr. Advs. with Mr. Abbot, Mr. Arshdeep Singh, Mr. Nitesh Gupta, Mr. Ayush Agarwa Ms. Sanjana Mishra, Mr. Krisna Gambhir, Ms. Shreya Sethi, Ms. Kumar, Advocates (M:9810259420 versus Jagati Publications Limited & Ors. .....Def Through: Ms. Amee Rana, Mr. Yash Karunakaran, Mr. Tanuj Sharma Tanvi Raina, Mr. Debditya Sah Advocates for D-6 (M:98189900 Email: varun.pathak@amsshardul.com Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Mini Pushkarna Order % 19.02.2026 I.A. 4829/2026 (For Exemption)
texts.facts: The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. This Court is informed that the plaintiffs have already paid the Court Fees of Rs. 97,65,000/- on Heritage Foods Limited & Anr vs Jagati Publications Limited & Ors on 19 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117887779/ 1 18th February, 2026, however, the said Court Fees is yet to be collected by them. 5. The said defendant shall file its written statement within thirty (30) days, from today. 13. Issue summons to defendant nos. 1 to 5 and 7 to 9, by all permissible modes, upon filing of Process Fee. 14. Summons shall state that the written statement be filed by the said defendants within thirty (30) days from the date of receipt of summons. 15. Along with the written statement, the defendants shall also file an affidavit of admission/denial of the plaintiffs documents, without which, the written statement shall not be taken on record. 16. Liberty is given to the plaintiffs to file replication(s), if any, within This is a digitally signed order. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 20/02/2026 at 20:46:57 thirty (30) days from the receipt of the written statement(s). Along with the replication(s) filed by the plaintiffs, the affidavit(s) of admission/denial of the documents of defendants be filed by the plaintiffs, without which, the replication(s) shall not be taken on record. 17. It is made clear that any unjustified denial of documents may lead to an order of costs against the concerned party. 21 . The present application has been filed seeking ex-parte interim reliefs against the defendants, thereby, restraining them from making, publishing, and circulating false, misleading and defamatory content against the plaintiffs. 22. It is submitted by learned Senior Counsel appearing for the plaintiffs that plaintiff no. 1-company is one of Indias leading dairy companies, and has established a reputed name for itself. The company was incorporated in the year 1992 by Mr. N. Chandrababu Naidu, who subsequently resigned in the year 1994. 23. The plaintiff no. 1 has received numerous awards and accolades for its business ethics and contributions to the society. In this regard, attention of this Court has been drawn to the following paragraphs from the plaint, which are reproduced as under: "xxx xxx xxx It is submitted that defendant nos. 1 to 4, on 14th February, 2026, have published false and incorrect statements in the Delhi edition of the newspaper being Sakshi Newspaper, and on the news channel being Sakshi TV, against the plaintiffs.
texts.arguments: By referring to the aforesaid, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the plaintiffs submits that the impugned article alleges that the plaintiff no. 1 company has ties with Bhole Baba Oroganic Dairy Milk Private Limited ("Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk"), which is a primary accused in the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam ("TTD") scam involving supply of adulterated Ghee. Thus, it is submitted that the impugned article seeks to allege that plaintiff no. 1-company, has also indulged in the TTD scam, and that the plaintiff no. 1 company has ties with said Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk. 26. Attention of this Court has also been drawn to the newspaper report dated 11th November, 2025, published in the Economic Times, wherein, Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk has been imputed for setting up fake Ghee manufacturing unit, used to prepare Tirupati Laddus. However, it is submitted that the plaintiffs have no connection with the aforesaid Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk. It is submitted that the plaintiff has business dealings with another entity, namely Bhole Baba Milk Food Industries (Dholpur) Private Limited ("Bhole Baba Milk Food"), and that the same is an entirely different entity from Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk, which is the accused in the TTD scam. Thus, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the plaintiffs submits that Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk and Bhole Baba Milk Food are distinct entities, and plaintiff no. 1-company has business ties with Bhole Baba Milk Food, and not Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk. In fact, plaintiff no. 1-company has never entered into any business dealings with Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk. 29. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the plaintiffs submits that the TTD scam is being investigated by the Central Bureau of Investigation ("CBI"), led by a Special Investigation Team ("SIT"). The SIT had registered a First Information Report ("FIR") against Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk and other accused persons, and two chargesheets have already been filed. Notably, neither the plaintiff no. 1-company, nor Bhole Baba Milk Food has been named in the FIR, or the chargesheets filed with regard to the TTD scam. 30. Thus, it is submitted that defendant nos. 1 to 4 have maliciously published the impugned article, making false and incorrect statements linking plaintiff no. 1 company with Bhole Baba Oroganic Milk, which is an accused in the TTD scam. It is further submitted that the defendant no. 4 company has made identical motivated allegations against the plaintiffs on the Sakshi TV news channel on 14th February, 2026. Further, the defendant no. 4 has also maliciously published the false narrative on the platform of defendant no. 8, i.e., YouTube, which has 2.5 billion monthly users. Thus, it is submitted that This is a digitally signed order. 32. It is submitted that the impugned reports have been published on all channels of Sakshi TV and on the platform maintained by defendant no. 8.
